summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, attaching a news release announcing results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. All nine director nominees were elected with high vote percentages, and shareholders also approved the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor and the say-on-pay advisory resolution. This is a routine disclosure of annual meeting outcomes, not a special situation. No deal terms, activist campaign, or strategic event is involved. Watch for regular quarterly updates and operational performance.
